text:
Marco Vega: FYI — kickoff for Boreal-North2 region with partners. Need capacity entitlements, marketplace SKU approval, and KMS onboarding timeline. Partners: CloudWave + HyperNode. Posting current asks and rough timeline below.

Priya Kapoor: thanks — can you paste the SKU/quotas here so I can start the marketplace request?

Marco Vega: sure — quick list:```
sku-boreal-gn1: 40 vGPUs (A10g preferred)
sku-boreal-gn2: 8 x A100-80GB (high perf pool)
sku-boreal-storage: 200TB block storage
network-eip: 50 reserved ips
quota-request-window: target May 2 -> May 15
```

Sam Lee: ops check — A10g is fine for baseline latency, but anything above 2k rps p95 will need A100s. We should reserve at least 8 A100s in the high-perf pool. @infra-bot can you confirm on physical availability?

infra-bot: Capacity probe complete — projected available across partners for May window: A10g: 64 units, A100-80GB: 12 units. Note: 1 maintenance event scheduled May 10 (low risk).

Nora Chen: legal note — CloudWave requires a DPA addendum and an IP carveout clause for model weights. We need signatures before marketplace entitlement. Jenna, can legal prioritize? ETA Fri EOD?

Jenna Ortiz: will ping Legal and Privacy. I'll get a draft addendum to the partner by Thu. If they push back on carveout language, we'll escalate to VP Legal.

Marco Vega: thanks. Two operational asks: 1) Priya — can you raise marketplace entitlement ticket with the SKU list and target dates? 2) Sam — can you open a partner capacity ticket with CloudWave referencing internal ticket CW-879?

Priya Kapoor: raising marketplace ticket now — internal id MP-4219. I added the SKU block and target window. Linking to CW-879 for cross-ref.

Sam Lee: opened CW-879 -> CloudWave contact (Elena) notified. Added notes about fallback routing to HyperNode if A100s drop below 6.

Marco Vega: quick checklist for everyone (summary):
- Marketplace entitlement ticket: MP-4219 (Priya)
- Partner capacity ticket: CW-879 (Sam)
- Legal DPA addendum draft: Jenna (ETA Thu)
- Infra capacity confirmation & maintenance note: infra-bot
- KMS onboarding (customer-managed keys): need cloud partner KMS IPs + HSM request — assign to Sam to coordinate with infra ops

Priya Kapoor: I'll schedule the initial canary rollout on May 16 with a small routing weight and monitor token-level latency. Playbook: /playbooks/region-rollout.md (ping me if you need access). :thumbsup:

Marco Vega: timeline constraint — marketing wants joint announcement week of May 20. To make that, we need marketplace entitlement + signed DPA by May 15. If legal slips, marketing will push.

Nora Chen: noted. I'll keep track of DPA sign-off in this thread.

Jenna Ortiz: updated — legal triage done, flagged for priority. I'll post the addendum link here when ready.

Marco Vega: small ops note: please add the following tags to the marketplace entitlement request: `region:boreal-north2`, `partner:cloudwave`, `launch:canary`, `sla:standard`. Also set fallback policy to route to `hypernode-eu-fallback` if A100 availability < 6.

Priya Kapoor: tags added to MP-4219. Also added a monitoring alert (alert id A-9983) to watch p95 token latency and GPU queue depth.

Sam Lee: I'll coordinate KMS onboarding with infra ops — creating infra ticket INF-3344 and cc'ing security. ETA for KMS keys: May 13 if partner provides URIs today.

Marco Vega: final ask — everyone drop status updates here by EOD tomorrow. I'll compile a launch readiness note for partners and marketing on Friday morning.

Priya Kapoor: will update.

Sam Lee: will update.

Jenna Ortiz: will update when addendum is sent.

Nora Chen: keeping watch.

Marco Vega: thanks team — summary pinned to MP-4219 and CW-879. If anything blocks, escalate in #release-war-room. :rocket:
